description_raw: Ron and Marilyn Renard started Ron's Wisconsin Cheese in February of 1976. In 2005 they sold their half of the business to their sons who operated Ron’s for the next nine years, until the company was purchased by John T. Pagel. The Pagel family continues to carry on the Renards' legacy of innovation and dedication to wholesome products. In addition to the Ron’s product line, they are the exclusive producer and distributor for Ponderosa Farmstead award-winning cheeses. Ponderosa Farmstead has grown significantly under the direction of Bryan Pagel, son of dairy visionary John T. Pagel. Their goal is to provide you and your family with farm-fresh cheese. Ron's Cheese wholesales its products to grocery stores, convenience stores, and restaurants throughout Wisconsin. Give them a call for your cheese needs!
name: Ron's Wisconsin Cheese

description_raw: BelGioioso Cheese, Inc. has been specializing in all-natural, award-winning Italian cheeses since 1979. This Wisconsin-based company consists of seven state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities around Denmark and Pulaski, Wisconsin. Through the years, BelGioioso cheeses have won many prestigious awards and have set a standard of excellence in the industry. We love their pure, distinctive flavors, and we know you will too - along with the amazing variety of styles, shapes, and sizes available to accommodate all your retail and food service needs.
name: BelGioioso Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: The Buholzer family of Klondike Cheese Co. has been making cheese in Wisconsin for four generations. Since the late 1800s, they have been creating award-winning feta, muenster, brick, and havarti cheeses in the rolling hills of Green County. Now, with six Wisconsin Master Cheesemakers on staff, Klondike continues to blend their expertise and creativity to craft many styles of specialty cheeses, and we love them all. Here’s a pro tip from us: Give Klondike's Odyssey feta a try. It is nationally recognized, and a constant award winner for a reason!
name: Klondike Cheese Company

description_raw: Back in 1910, a group of local family farms looked to establish a consistent, trustworthy market for their rBST-free milk and Maple Leaf Cheese Co-op was born. Fast forward to the present, Maple Leaf is still locally farmer-owned and recently celebrated 100 years in the cheesemaking business. Cheeses at Maple Leaf reflect the pride and care exhibited by small family farms that utilize quality milk to make handcrafted cheeses, and it's something you can taste in their delicious small batch cheeses. From traditional cheddar (you'll love the Gold Medal World Champion English Hollow cheddar) to the best-selling cranberry white cheddar, Maple Leaf is sure to please the most avid cheese lover. Maple Leaf's own Master Cheesemakers also craft award-winning jack cheeses. We recommend the flavored jacks with chipotle and habanero, they're sure to heat up your next party.
name: Maple Leaf Cheese Co

description_raw: Biery Cheese is all about family. And cheese! They're a family-owned company dedicated to crafting delicious cheese that your family will love. Currently led by the fourth generation of the Biery family, they are committed to excellence throughout every level of the company. Offering a range of sliced, block, and shredded cheeses, artisan cheeses, and party trays (think: delicious cheeses with traditionally-cured meats and hearty crackers), Biery is one family you'll want to be a part of.
name: Biery Cheese Company

description_raw: Jim’s Cheese has been distributing Wisconsin’s Finest Cheese since 1955. Located in Waterloo, Wisconsin, the facility includes a cut and wrap operation, cheese-waxing operation, gift box assembly, cold storage as well as their corporate offices. Jim’s Cheese started out with four wholesale customers and today, services over 2,000 customers in 12 Midwest states. Their Lake Forest artisan line consists of specialty, artisan and farmstead products from over (20) Wisconsin cheesemakers, noting that each cheesemaker has a unique offering of flavors, styles and cultural origin that appeal to cheese enthusiasts throughout the country.
name: JLM Manufacturing LLC

description_raw: Ellsworth Cooperative Creamery was established in 1910. A dairy cooperative with 400 family dairy farms, Ellsworth specializes in the production of 500-pound barrel cheddar cheese and whey, bagged or bulk. In 1983, Ellsworth, Wisconsin, was proclaimed the "Cheese Curd Capital of Wisconsin" by Governor Anthony Earl. Today, there are six exciting flavors of cheese curds available: natural, garlic, cajun, ranch, hot buffalo, and taco. Fresh curds are available 7 days a week at 11 am at the Ellsworth location, so give them a visit! Another reason to visit: the stores carry over 200 varieties of Wisconsin Cheese. There's lots to love here.
name: Ellsworth Cooperative Creamery

description_raw: It all started in 1988 when a handful of Midwest family farmers became fed up with the state of American agriculture, and the fact that family farms were becoming extinct. So, they decided to do something about it...and Organic Valley was born. Focused on its founding mission of saving family farms through organic farming, Organic Valley produces a variety of award-winning organic foods, including milk, soy, cheese, butter, spreads, creams, eggs and produce, which are sold in supermarkets, natural foods stores and food cooperatives nationwide. The same farmers who produce for Organic Valley also produce a full range of delicious organic meat under the Organic Prairie Family of Farms label. Now, 30 years later, Organic Valley continues to produce some of the highest quality organic dairy, vegetables, soy and eggs available. Moreover, their mission to create a healthier future never ends.
name: CROPP Cooperative/Organic Valley

description_raw: For Welcome Dairy, Inc., the making of process cheese is a traditional craft. It has traveled the years (since 1899, to be exact), and it's an art that still evolves and develops as each generation adds its own fresh ideas and individual innovations. Welcome Dairy products come from a blending of over 100 years of country art with the latest technologies. This means that no dairy provides a higher-quality, more versatile selection of cheeses. It also means that innovation and excellence permeate every part of their business. Alongside technological upgrades, quality still comes from the same place it always has: The heart and the hands of the people who make Welcome Dairy.
name: Welcome Dairy LLC

description_raw: Widmer’s Cheese Cellars settled in the heart of one of the richest cheesemaking areas in America in 1922. Now, over 100 years later and in their fourth-generation of Widmer family ownership, they are the proud manufacturers of authentic hand-crafted cheeses from mild and washed-rind brick cheeses to authentic stirred-curd colby, and cheddars aged up to 10 years. Widmer's has been the recipient of many blue ribbon awards - both in Wisconsin and across the nation. We are big fans of one of their newest products - the Aged Brick Cheese Spread. This spread is a combination of washed rind brick cheese and aged white cheddar, bringing you the best of both cheese worlds.
name: Widmer's Cheese Cellars, Inc.

description_raw: Nestled in the rolling hills of west central Wisconsin, just 35 miles from LaCrosse and the Mississippi River, you'll find Westby Creamery. Formed in 1903, Westby is a locally owned co-op that markets the farmers' cream. Initially a butter producer, Westby Creamery now produces cottage cheese, sour cream, French onion dip, yogurt, cheese curds, butter and cheddar, monterey jack, colby and colby jack cheeses. All products are rBST-free, and they also manufacture organic products. For Westby, the dairy business is a daily business. Cow care is 24/7/365, with cows being fed and milked at least twice a day, every day of the year. And that's how everything starts at Westby Creamery.
name: Westby Cooperative Creamery

description_raw: Cedar Grove Cheese traces its beginnings all the way back to 1878. Today, this family-owned operation produces a variety of organic, specialty cheeses, and cheese curds. Cedar Grove guarantees the best traditional and specialty cheese you've ever tasted - without artificial growth hormones (rBGH), animal enzymes, or genetically modified ingredients (GMOs). We especially love that they spread the Wisconsin love, buying milk from over 30 Wisconsin farmers!
name: Cedar Grove Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: Sartori is a fourth-generation, family owned, tried-and-true Wisconsin cheese producer. Their premium artisan cheese has won over 330 of the most prestigious domestic and international awards - like the 2017 International Cheese Awards for Espresso BellaVitano™ and Best in Show at the 2017 U.S. Championship Cheese Contest for Black Pepper BellaVitano™. With all their delicious varieties and innovations, we sure are glad the Sartori family is a part of the Wisconsin cheese family, too.
name: Sartori Cheese Company

description_raw: Founded in 1885 by five dairy farmers, Chalet Cheese Cooperative continues to flourish as a co-operative owned and operated by its 14 members who are the sole suppliers of milk. They specialize in the making of Limburger, Brick, Baby Swiss, and Swiss, and their smoked versions, with an emphasis on top quality and true workmanship. Fun fact: the folks at Chalet are the only producers of Limburger in the United States, and their German Brick with a Limburger smear underscores their spirit for innovation. The quality of Chalet's Baby Swiss, regular Swiss, smoked Baby Swiss and smoked Swiss cheeses are recognized often, winning numerous (126!) awards in competitions from the U.S. Championship Cheese Contest to the World Championship Cheese Contest.
name: Chalet Cheese Cooperative

description_raw: In 1964, Gilberto Villaseñor and Ignacio Villaseñor accomplished a longstanding dream: to produce a fresh cheese that reflected the traditions of their native Mexico. The company they founded, V&V Supremo Foods, Inc., is now an industry leader in the fastest growing food category in both the retail and food service segments: premium, authentic Mexican-style food products. The family chose to make cheese in Wisconsin since it reminded them of their dairy-rich state at home in Mexico. Now, it is also the oldest Hispanic family-run cheese manufacturer in the U.S. V&V Supremo Oaxaca and Chihuahua® Queso Quesadilla are manufactured in their Wisconsin cheese plant. Today, 50+ years after their founding, V&V continues to preserve and share delicious traditions of the Mexican American kitchen as well as cuisines of the world, one cheese at a time.
name: V & V Supremo Foods, Inc.

description_raw: Lynn Dairy, and the Schwantes family behind it, is a cheese manufacturing plant with strong values. The Schwantes run a friendly, fair and creative work environment that respects diversity, new ideas and hard work. Lynn Dairy has won numerous awards over the years because of their top quality and flavor. A Master Cheesemaker on staff ensures the best product possible, and Lynn Dairy continuously tries to improve their products and make changes when necessary. There are over 20 different flavors of cheese available and always more coming! Now in their fourth-generation of family ownership, Lynn Dairy takes the time to care for their customers and prides themselves on their dedication to the industry.
name: Lynn Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: Henning Cheese is a family operation crafting traditional artisan and specialty cheese in rural Kiel, Wisconsin, since 1914. Their focus is on quality not quantity. They use fresh milk from small local family dairy farmers and follow slow traditional make procedures. They craft traditional Cheddar, Colby, Monterey Jack, Farmers, Mozza Whips, fresh Cheddar Cheese Curds and a wide variety of unique Cheddar flavors. Some of these include Mango Fire Cheddar, Blueberry Cobbler Cheddar, Peppercorn Cheddar, Pico de Queso Cheddar and Dragon’s Breath Cheddar. They also have a line of seasonal flavors which includes their very popular, Hatch Chile Cheddar. Under the watchful eye of Master Cheesemaker Kerry Henning and 4th generation family cheesemakers, Joshua Henning and Zachary Henning, Henning Cheese cheeses have won countless awards over the years. Their plant is Level 3 SQF certified and USDA approved. Cheese is available to purchase in retail cuts, 40 lb. blocks and wheels that range from 12-pound midgets to 4000-pound mammoths. Henning Cheese is the only plant that makes mammoth wheels of cheese for store promotions and events.
name: Henning Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: Wisconsin Cheese Group produces a wide array of cheeses, chorizos, and desserts that are always crafted with your family in mind. This includes authentic Hispanic and Caribbean cheese under El Viajero, La Morenita, Caribe and Reynaldo's brands, including but not limited to: queso fresco, panela, oaxaca, quesadilla, cotija, blanco, para freir, boricua, Colombiano, Dominicano and queso de papa. Included in the El Viajero line up: Bio Salud!, a probiotic cultured dairy beverage, traditional cremas, restaurant-style dipping cheese, and edam balls. Wisconsin Cheese Group also produces and distributes domestic cheese under the Wisconsin Farms brand including cheddar, medium cheddar, sharp cheddar, colby, colby jack, mozzarella, muenster, pepper jack, provolone and swiss. Once you discover the range of Wisconsin Cheese Group's products, you'll be serving the "taste of tradition" each time.
name: Wisconsin Cheese Group, LLC

description_raw: Did you know Durand boasts one of the finest cheese plants in the State of Wisconsin? It's true! Family owned since 1945, Eau Galle Cheese proudly produces millions of pounds of cheese each year - one delicious item at a time. Founder Leo Buhlman was born and trained in Switzerland, and his son, John Buhlman, continues to produce some of the finest Parmesan, Romano, and Asiago cheese in the United States. They have the award wins to prove it; at the 2015 U.S. Championship Cheese Contest Dupont took First Place for Parmesan, and at the 2019 U.S. Championship Cheese Contest they claimed First Place for Aged Asiago and Fresh Asiago.

locations.name: Eau Galle Cheese, Gifts and Collectibles

name: Cheese Merchants of America

description_raw: Specialty Cheese Company is one of the nation's top manufacturers of Hispanic, Indian, Middle Eastern, Greek, Polish, Filipino and other ethnic cheeses. They also manufacture their unique Crunchy Baked Cheese snacks - a healthy, crunchy snack that is shelf-stable and nutritious. In addition, you'll find exotic frying cheeses with flavors such as pineapple and mango, garlic and chive, jalapeno and more. Fun fact: In 1991, Specialty Cheese Company purchased five old cheese factories dating back to the 1860’s. While the exact dates of these factories are a bit obscure, the oldest factory had been making cheese continuously for 160 years. You see, the earliest real estate deed Specialty Cheese Company could find for that factory simply said that when it was sold in 1860 it was already being used as a cheese factory. That makes the plant the oldest cheese plant in Wisconsin - with a roadside plaque to show it.
name: Specialty Cheese Company, Inc

description_raw: Zimmerman Cheese, Inc. has been practicing the art of cheesemaking for four generations and has been located in Wiota, Wisconsin since 1979. Their house specialties, baby swiss and muenster, have won numerous awards throughout the years and are made with pride, reflecting the company's Swiss family heritage. Since the 1970's, Zimmerman has also been producing brick, baby jack, farmer, monterey jack and smoked baby swiss. Newest additions include low sodium cheeses, asadero, and queso quesadilla. Zimmerman Cheese and its employees take great pride in the idea of quality, not quantity. In fact, it's a company philosophy.
name: Zimmerman Cheese Company, Inc.

description_raw: Made by cheese lovers for cheese lovers, Crystal Farms Refrigerated Distribution Company (RDC) delivers unparalleled quality at a great value. Crystal Farms' cheese processing plant is located in Lake Mills, Wisconsin, where they have access to the best cheese from select dairies throughout Wisconsin and the Midwest. It's clearly one reason why, since 1926, they've accomplished their primary goal of providing customers high quality products at a better value. You'll find only the finest-quality, best-tasting Wisconsin dairy products from Crystal Farms RDC.
name: Crystal Farms - Michael Foods, Inc.

description_raw: Tony and Julie Hook have been making artisan cheddar, blue cheese, world champion colby and many other varieties for over 45 years. Established in 1976, Hook's Cheese Company is a family owned and operated business located in the historic Shake Rag district of scenic Mineral Point, Wisconsin. Their cheese is aged in curing caves at just the right temperature and humidity for a slow-curing process that allows cheeses to age to perfection. Every few months, each batch is taste tested to ensure that only the cheeses of the highest quality are aged as evidenced by their two, three, four, five, six and seven year aged cheddars, as well as their highly acclaimed ten year sharp cheddar, which won an ACS first place in 2006! Hook's also makes a variety of other cow, sheep and goat milk cheeses, so don't stop at the cheddar. One cheese, born in 2014, is called Triple Play and uses all three milks cow, sheep, goat, and offers flavor notes of baby swiss, gouda and havarti.
name: Hook's Cheese Company, Inc.

description_raw: In 1974, Leonard “Butch” Gentine started Masters Gallery Foods as a small brokerage firm that purchased, aged, and distributed large blocks of bulk cheese for industrial customers. Today, the company is a leading national cheese supplier with one of the largest privately held cheese inventories in the country, and operates two state-of-the-art production and distribution facilities in Plymouth and Oostburg. Specializing in shredding, chunking, slicing and snacks, the company supplies private label retail and food service products to customers across the country. True to their founding, Masters continues to service bulk industrial and food ingredient customers around the world. The right people delivering the right cheese is what Masters Gallery Foods is all about (oh, and variety, too)!
name: Masters Gallery Foods, Inc.

description_raw: Foremost Farms USA is a dairy cooperative representing hundreds of Midwest dairy farmer members located across seven Midwest states, including Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Ohio and Wisconsin - America's Dairyland. It is one of the largest, leading dairy cooperatives in the United States and a major food manufacturing business. Every year, Foremost Farms produces millions of pounds of cheese, butter, whey and milk protein ingredients from the high-quality milk produced by its members. Its customers represent respected top brands and category leaders at national and regional levels in retail and foodservice channels, that are served with innovative solutions, technical services and customized products.
name: Foremost Farms USA Cooperative

description_raw: Established in 1902, our family-owned and operated business reflects a heritage of four generations of cheesemakers who have continued to practice the art in the traditional way since the late 1880's. We are a local business serving our customers nation-wide with an award winning reputation for quality Cheddar. We make our Cheddar available in such styles as 37-pound flats, 23-pound daisies, 12 pound midgets, 5 1/2-pound favorites and 3-pound gems. In addition, we make many varieties of American Originals which include cow, goat, sheep and mixed milk cheeses. Traditional favorites such as Fontina, Gouda, Blue, and Swiss are made by Master Cheesemakers. At Carr Valley, we currently have 3 Master Cheesemakers on staff. We utilize specialized affinage techniques that bring out the unique flavor and diversity our cheeses are known for. These specialties have won over 400 national and international awards. Our on-site retail store is also home to an ever-growing mail order service, with customers nationwide. Many of those customers have viewed the cheesemaking process and the age-old method of "waxing" from our observation window. We presently manufacture over 90 varieties of cheese that are sold in our own retail stores, as well as national retailers. In addition, our cheese can be enjoyed at fine dining restaurants all over the country. If you would like to taste it for yourself, you can visit one of our 7 stores, or order online at www.carrvalleycheese.com

locations.name: Carr Valley Cheese Factory & Retail Store

name: Carr Valley Cheese Company, Inc.

description_raw: In the 1950s, George Merkt and his wife set up a small cheese and sausage shop near Salem, Wisconsin. That storefront was the beginning of Merkts Cheese Company, giving birth to a cheesemaking tradition of 100% real Wisconsin cheddar that continues to this day. These days, Merkts cheese spreads are produced under the name of Bel Brands USA in Little Chute, Wisconsin, and as always, only made with 100% real Wisconsin cheddar.
name: Bel Brands USA

description_raw: Home is where the cheese is. At least that’s the belief at Lactalis American Group, the company behind Président cheese. Lactalis is passionate about serving up great cheese, and they know you are too. You want to make the most of every moment with your loved ones, so you look for delicious, nutritious food that you can easily make at home. You won't settle for anything less than exceptional quality and taste. Président’s 80 years of expertise in crafting specialty cheese pairs with your creativity to perfectly complement life's occasions. Because Lactalis understands the power of food to connect people, unite cultures and enrich daily life, they stand today as one of the world's leading cheese producers. Great cheese is who they are, pure and simple.
name: Lactalis USA, Inc.

description_raw: Schreiber Foods brings delicious dairy to the world and enriches lives in the process. Founded in Green Bay in 1945, they specialize in yogurt, natural cheese, processed cheese and cream cheese that meet customers’ needs and appeal to consumer tastes worldwide. They've come a long way since their start as a small process cheese company. Today, the Schreiber team is more than 7,000 strong at locations across North America, Europe, South America and Asia, and their commitment to providing safe food the right way has never changed. To Schrieber, success means ensuring the food they provide is always safe for people to enjoy everywhere. It also means doing business in a way that is good for their people, their communities and our Earth. Serving the common good is just part of who they are as a company and as individuals.
name: Schreiber Foods, Inc.

description_raw: During the 19th century in the Swiss Alps on Mt. Horber, the Wüthrich family ranged a herd of dairy cattle and made cheese. In 1893, Samuel and Katharina Wüthrich immigrated to Wisconsin to pursue the American Dream. With them, they brought the family tradition of cheese making. Samuel and Katharina’s son, John S., worked alongside his father making cheese. In 1904, a group of farmers began a creamery outside of the Greenwood Township, and Grassland Dairy Products, Inc. was born. John S. served as the general manager, making cheese in the morning, and picking up cream from neighbors and hand-churning it into butter in the afternoon. Grassland is proud to provide a wide range of dairy products to this day, and proudly remains one of the leading family-owned butter manufacturers in the world.
name: Grassland Dairy Products, Inc.

description_raw: Grande crafts “the finest Italian cheeses money can buy," blending the best ingredients and latest technology with the skill of Old World craftsmen. Perfection is guaranteed in every bite. "Making fine cheese, like making fine wine, is indeed an art steeped in tradition and pride. We here at Grande are proud of our company, each other, and the cheese we make. And, we're committed to continuing the art of making fine Italian cheese passed down by our founder, Filippo Candela." - John Candela, Chairman.
name: Grande Cheese Company

description_raw: Generation after generation, Wisconsin Dairy State Cheese continues setting new standards and upholding the tradition for high-quality cheeses made in Wisconsin. The superior milk supplied by dedicated dairy farm families and their Master Cheesemakers artistry allows them to produce a most excellent and unique cheese product. Just ask Wisconsin Trails Magazine, which voted Wisconsin Dairy State the #1 place to buy Wisconsin cheese! Wisconsin Dairy State also conducts tours of their facility and features a film on cheesemaking. And if that wasn't enough, you'll find over 16 different flavors of absolutely scrumptious ice cream made in our very own state of Wisconsin. So much yum!

locations.name: Wisconsin Dairy State Cheese Co, Inc

name: Wisconsin Dairy State Cheese Co, Inc

description_raw: Cheesemaker Willi Lehner of Bleu Mont Dairy has been drawing praise from big-city food writers for more than 20 years now. The son of a Swiss cheesemaker who came to the States in the early 1950s, Lehner has cheesemaking in his DNA. Today, he adds to his Swiss repertoire with original cheeses he creates using his cheesemaking expertise and the controlled environment of his straw bale-aging cave. You can find Bleu Mont Dairy - and Willi’s signature bandaged cheddar - in the beautiful rolling hills near Blue Mounds, Wisconsin.
name: Bleu Mont Dairy

description_raw: Burnett Dairy Cooperative is a place where farm families work side-by-side with crop and dairy experts to produce the highest quality products from the ground up. They've been proudly farmer-owned since 1896, and great things have been happening ever since. In 1988, they won the distinction of World Champion Cheesemaker with an entry of their now famous string cheese. If you visit their retail cheese store and bistro in the beauty of Alpha, Wisconsin, the folks at Burnett will be happy to fry up some cheese curds (a true Wisconsin delicacy), bake you a pizza, grill you a gourmet panini, or make you an ice cream cone. Treat yourself!
name: Burnett Dairy Cooperative

description_raw: Scray Cheese is a family owned, fourth generation artisan cheese factory and shop located in De Pere, Wisconsin. They've been handcrafting cheddar, edam, fontina and gouda cheese since 1924. If you find yourself in the Green Bay Area, stop into the Scray Cheese Shoppe for some fresh squeaky cheese curds and a cup of coffee while watching cheese being made. The shop is just miles from historic Lambeau Field. Monday, Tuesday and Thursday mornings are the best times to see the most cheese production, but if you stay a while you'll also find Wisconsin meats, Door County wines, specialty coffees and premium ice cream to be enjoyed. Experience true Wisconsin heritage with Scray's!
name: Scray Cheese Company

description_raw: Family owned and operated since 1970, Mullins Cheese knows you'll find a cheese in their portfolio that's just irresistible. From asiago to brick to the most classic of them all (Wisconsin colby), Mullins has been making and loving this stuff for over 40 years. Founder John Mullins came from a background of cheesemaking, having been exposed at an early age to his father’s cheese manufacturing business, and the company has only grown in capabilities since then. Today, you can visit them, and the World's Largest Round Barn, in Marshfield, Wisconsin!
name: Mullins Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: Since 1911 - and over 100 years now - four generations of Metzigs have owned and operated Union Star Cheese Factory. David Metzig and his wife, Jan, bought Union Star from Great Aunt Edna in 1980. Like his Great Grand Uncle, David was interested in using his accounting degree to run his own business. And of course, the business was cheese! The family tradition of independent cheesemaking has carried through to this day and now, David's sons are also part of the Union Star story. David Metzig has earned the title of Master Cheesemaker and the Union Star Cheese Factory has been voted as one of Wisconsin's Best by Wisconsin Trails Magazine readers. Give Union a visit to see a real cheese factory in operation and learn more about how the finest Wisconsin cheese is made!
name: Union Star, Corp.

description_raw: Renard's Cheese was started in 1961, and for the past 57 years has been an icon in Door County business. Renard's is a family-owned and operated business that is now in its third generation of cheesemakers. Today, Chris Renard, Master Cheesemaker, and his wife, Ann Renard, own both Renard's Cheese stores and the Rosewood Dairy factory where all the cheese is produced. The Renard family is committed to continuing the tradition of hand-crafted specialty cheese while producing quality, gourmet cheese that is perfectly blended. Chris earned his Master Cheesemaker Certification in 2014 – a nationally acclaimed title. While many things have changed over the years, the Renard's recipe remains the same. This precise art has awarded the Renard's not only a reputation of great standards but also a product that they are proud to put their name on.
name: Rosewood Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: Laack Bros. Cheese Co., Inc. began in 1986 as a cheese and butter wholesaler. Through the years, they have added cheese cutting, packaging and shredding, plus cold pack and cream cheese spread manufacturing to their profile. They have routes that run on a weekly basis distributing cheese products in and out of Wisconsin, i.e., distributors, food processors, bakers, c-stores, restaurants, grocery stores, etc. Laack Bros. are proudly family run, and proudly Wisconsin.
name: Laack Brothers Cheese Company

description_raw: Founded three generations ago, Meister Cheese Company remains true to the ideals of founder Joseph Meister, who was committed to making only the finest quality cheeses, and the Kase Meister label honors his legacy. Kase Meister's award-winning cheddar is handcrafted and captures their forefathers’ tradition through their third-generation experience, technology and ingenuity. Meister Cheese manufactures and packages premium colby and colby-jack, as well as unique flavors of award-winning monterey jack and cheddar cheeses. With options like wild morel and leek, chipotle, horseradish, spring onion, salsa, bruschetta and muscada mayhem, you're bound to have a new and exciting cheese experience – one that's rooted in only the finest quality.
name: Meister Cheese Co LLC

description_raw: Saputo Cheese values developing its brands, producing a wide assortment of cheeses, and providing consistency, value, and flavor. You'll find quite a few here, like the Stella® brand Italian cheeses that have been made in northern Wisconsin for 100 years. America’s original cave-aged blue cheese, Treasure Cave® Cheeses are aged in a state-of-the-art facility in Almena, Wisconsin. Black Creek® cheddars, available in 9-month, 2-year, 3-year, Cheddar with Parmesan Notes, and Cheddar with Gruyère options, are crafted under the supervision of Wisconsin Master Cheesemakers. Great Midwest® artisan flavored jack and cheddar cheeses elevate the snacking experience, offering Cranberry, Blueberry Cobbler and Mango Fire among other flavor varieties. The company also makes Saputo® Premium Gold mozzarella and Lugano® mozzarella. Consistency, value, flavor and Wisconsin cheese for all!
name: Saputo Cheese USA

description_raw: Carr Cheese Factory, a small cheese plant that produces small vats of excellent quality cheese, has been operated by the Gile Family since 1946. They've received numerous awards for their baby swiss, colby, cheddar, monterey jack, colby jack and many flavored cheeses. Try one of their many Wisconsin varieties: you'll find cheddar, cheddar cheese curd, tomato-basil cheddar, garlic-onion cheddar, mild colby, 50-50 (colby jack), monterey jack, pepper jack, pesto jack, habanero jack and garden vegetable jack, baby swiss, reduced fat and sodium baby swiss, reduced fat and sodium cheddar, and lacy baby swiss. And, you'll find fresh cheese curds in their shop once every week!
name: Gile Cheese, LLC

description_raw: Established over 100 years ago, Valley View Cheese Co-op is still in business today at the same original location. Current cheesemaker Hans Lehner has been in business since 1979. After learning the art of cheesemaking from his father, Billi, a Swiss immigrant, together the father son duo went on to win numerous awards at the state, national and international level, including U.S. and World Championships! Valley View specializes in high-quality and very tasteful cheeses. Two cheesemakers on staff have won the coveted H.P. Mulloy Award, a top honor, and today a 3rd generation cheesemaker has joined the team, Lehner's own son, Hansi Lehner Jr., who has won awards at the U.S. Cheese Championship himself!
name: Valley View Cheese Cooperative

description_raw: Cedar Valley Cheese, Inc. was founded in 1947. Starting small, the plant expanded several times over the years, growing from two employees to 60. Today, Cedar Valley Cheese has eight licensed cheesemakers including one Master Cheesemaker. The company has received the Seal of Excellence Award at the State Fair five times for its string cheese. The company also received a red ribbon on their provolone and mozzarella cheeses. Proudly Wisconsin, indeed!
name: Cedar Valley Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: For over 50 years, Swiss Valley Farms, a nationally known and recognized dairy cooperative, has been a strong presence in the upper Midwest dairy industry, providing a secure market for the quality milk produced by its Member-Owners. Their five cheese production facilities, located in Iowa, Minnesota, and right here in Shullsburg and Mindoro, Wisconsin, produce award-winning swiss, baby swiss, maasdam, gouda, blue, gorgonzola, cream cheese, neufchatel and sweet whey, as well as pasteurized process cheeses, cold pack club blends, enzyme-modified cheeses and cheese analogs. They proudly uphold a fresh-from-the-farm philosophy, which means you'll always get great tasting dairy products when you choose Swiss Valley Farms.
name: Prairie Farms Dairy, Inc

description_raw: Nasonville Dairy began creating delicious cheese way back in 1885, and the Heiman family has been running the farm since the 1960s. Today, spanning multiple generations – father, sons and grandchildren – they continue to carry forward the knowledge and passion for cheesemaking within Wisconsin. Nasonville Dairy proudly supports local dairy farmers, using the milk from neighbors’ farms (over 1.5 million pounds per day) to make products fresh and Wisconsin proud. Three generations of the Heiman family are committed to blending nature, science, artistry and tradition for their signature scrumptious and delightful cheese. Their passion ensures they will never stop learning – the family dairy has licensed cheesemakers along with Master Cheesemakers Ken, Tom and Brian. Their desire for award-winning, exceptional cheese is something we know you'll taste and believe.
name: Nasonville Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: Since 1899, Brunkow Cheese of Wisconsin has been creating over 50 varieties of artisanal and specialty cheeses in the rolling hills of rural Darlington. In addition to crafting cheese by hand in small batches, they also age the cheeses on site. From aged cheddars and flavored jacks, to raw milk cheddar spreads, flaming juustos and cellar-aged artisanal cheeses, we love that everything at Brunkow Cheese is handcrafted with pride and dedication.
name: Brunkow Cheese of Wisconsin, Inc.

description_raw: Since 1936, the Wiskerchen name has been synonymous with high-quality dairy products. Now under third generation ownership in Auburndale, Wisconsin, Wiskerchen Cheese Inc. continues to thrive, producing specialty cheeses for a vast array of quality and food safety-conscious consumers. Cheeses range from blue cheese to feta, and gorgonzola to specialty conversions. They strive to give every customer the best service and attention to detail they deserve. Wiskerchen loves what they do and feels fortunate to keep carrying on the family tradition, leading by example.
name: Wiskerchen Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: For more than 80 years, Ornua Ingredients North America has been associated with quality cheese. While their roots are in natural cheesemaking, today they use that same expertise to custom formulate and manufacture a complete line of pasteurized process cheese/cheese ingredients. These include processed cheese, cheese food, cheese spreads, shelf stable, imitation, substitute, reduced fat, fat free, nutritionally fortified cheeses, blends, sauces, easy melt/high melt, blue cheese, retort, cream cheese-type products and club cheese. They bring the flavor to food manufacturers and foodservice operators nationwide for use in their products. Ornua Ingredients’ customers range from well-known, Fortune 100 companies to small businesses in the food processing and foodservice markets. But, no matter your size, Ornua Ingredients will treat you as a valued friend…because that's what you are!
name: Ornua Ingredients North America

description_raw: Decatur Swiss Cheese Co-op has been making cheese for the ages since the 1940s! Steve Stettler is a Wisconsin Master Cheesemaker who has developed several new cheeses for the Co-op, including a European style havarti, a swiss-lace cheese called Stettler Swiss, and a colby-swiss marbled cheese. These cheeses have won awards like the 2013 Wisconsin State Fair for havarti pepper, and 2012 First Place in the World Championship Cheese Contest in havarti for havarti pepper. Decatur Cheese Cooperative (Decatur Dairy) and Steve and Glennette Stettler thank you for your patronage and hope you enjoy!
name: Decatur Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: In 1863, Oswald Roth began crafting and curing cheese in Uster, Switzerland. Eventually, the family’s expertise was brought to America’s Dairyland. Today, Roth Cheese is part of the Emmi Group, continuing to focus on specialty and artisan cheeses that originated in the traditions of European recipes, as well as creating American Originals. With authentic copper vats and affinage cellars, Roth cheeses are a testament to the craft of the cheesemaker. The full range of Roth award-winning specialty cheeses includes the flagship cheese, Grand Cru®, a washed-rind, cellar-cured Alpine-style cheese cured four months or more; Buttermilk Blue®, a lusciously, creamy raw-milk Blue; Vintage Van Gogh®, a full-cream aged gouda with undertones of caramel and coffee; GranQueso®, a Roth original with a distinctive bite and lingering sweet finish; and Roth havarti, made with the freshest milk and premium quality ingredients to ensure a consistently delicious versatile cheese experience.
name: Emmi Roth USA

description_raw: Oak Grove Dairy is in its third generation of specializing in the making of American types of cheese. Their newly updated plant is one of the very few making traditional 6-inch longhorns and the specialty 4-inch “mini” deli horns. Oak Grove takes pride in producing fine Wisconsin cheeses using local farms and the highest quality ingredients. They invite you to stop by Shawano County's last cheese factory where you'll find a small store on site to meet all your colby, colby-jack, cheddar, pepper, vegetable, monterey jack and peppered colby-jack cheese needs!
name: Oak Grove Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: Gibbsville Cheese is located in the heart of Sheboygan County, Wisconsin, with a rich family history of cheesemaking for over 65 years! Purchased by the Van Tatenhove family in 1933, Gibbsville Cheese continues to be a family-run operation in their third generation of cheesemaking. Cheddar, colby, and monterey jack, and a variety of flavored cheeses are their stars, along with a Special Reserve Super Sharp Cheddar that is tested by their cheesemaker to assure the quality reaches "Special Reserve" standards. Famous cheese curds are made on Tuesdays, and Gibbsville also ships across the United States, ensuring you can ship and receive real Wisconsin fresh Gibbsville Cheese at any time. (Make sure you visit on Tuesdays, though.)
name: Gibbsville Cheese Company, Inc.

description_raw: Located in the heart of Amish country in Wisconsin, Pasture Pride crafts cheese with milk from local Amish dairies that is delivered to the factory in chilled milk cans the old-fashioned way. They produce many varieties of cheese, including Pasture Pride cheddars, monterey jack, pepper jack, muenster, colby and co-jack. In addition, Pasture Pride Cheese is the home of “Juusto™” cheese - a Finnish baked cheese manufactured in their factory in Wisconsin. Juusto™ has been judged “Best of Show” in numerous cheese competitions, and has a butter flavor we know you'll savor. Juust try Juusto™!
name: Pasture Pride Cheese, LLC

description_raw: Arla Foods, Inc. is a cooperative owned by more than 13,400 dairy farmers in Northern Europe, with production in 13 countries and products sold in over 100 countries around the globe. In 1998, Arla Foods’ cheese experts, using Danish know-how, began manufacturing high quality havarti cheese in Wisconsin at Hollandtown Dairy. Today, Hollandtown Dairy produces a variety of cheese types and flavors using the high quality standards and specifications of the original European recipes. When Europe meets Wisconsin, great things happen!
name: Arla Foods, Inc.

description_raw: LaGrander's Hillside Dairy, Inc. has been owned and operated by the LaGrander family since 1960 and is now in its third generation of cheesemakers. Specialties include their award-winning colby, cheddar, monterey jack, colby-jack and pepper jack cheeses, as well as fresh and frozen cheese curds for retail and wholesale. LaGrander's Hillside Dairy is committed to producing superior cheese products that exceed all quality standards and customer expectations.
name: LaGrander's Hillside Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: The Sargento Family represents three generations of real cheese people. Third-Generation CEO, Louis P. Gentine II, describes it best: "My grandfather had a simple philosophy: 'Hire good people, and treat them like family. His philosophy guides everything we do. It allows us to bring only the very best real, natural cheese to your family.' Today, the company is now wholly-owned by the Gentines and is in its third generation of family management. Sargento has established a reputation as an innovator of products, packaging and merchandising, being the first to market shredded natural cheese, sliced natural cheese & natural cheese blends. We'll leave you with a fun fact: the Sargento name is a combination of the two founders' names: Joseph Sartori and Leonard A. Gentine Sr.
name: Sargento Foods, Inc.

description_raw: After 100 years, Silver Lewis Cheese, one of the original four-corner crossroad cheese factories perched on the back roads of Wisconsin, is not only still making cheese, but is going full speed ahead. The small factory located in Monticello, Wisconsin has been operating since 1897 and is known for its brick and muenster Cheese. They also make a wide variety of other cheeses which are sold factory direct or shipped anywhere in the U.S. We're fans of the veggie cheese – monterey jack with a plethora of vegetables mixed in.
name: Silver Lewis Cheese Factory Cooperative

description_raw: Arena Cheese, one of Wisconsin's oldest factories, is located in the Wisconsin River Valley within the lush, green, rolling hills of the Spring Green area. It's the proud home of the original co-jack cheese. In the long-standing reputation for this "Wisconsin Original" created in 1979, Arena's cheesemakers have crafted co-jack in the same location with the same recipe and cheesemaking techniques since its discovery more than three decades ago. Look out for the mouse in front of the cheese and gift store.
name: Arena Cheese

description_raw: Uplands Cheese sits up on top of Pleasant Ridge in the Driftless region of southwestern Wisconsin. Owned and operated by two families, Andy and Caitlin Hatch, and Scott and Liana Mericka, Uplands milks cows seasonally, in time with the pastures, to make two traditional, artisan cheeses. Pleasant Ridge Reserve is made with grass-fed milk in the summer months, while Rush Creek Reserve is made in the fall when the cows' diet changes to hay. Pleasant Ridge has won Best in Show at the American Cheese Society's annual competition in 2001, 2005 and 2010. Give it one try and you'll taste how truly amazing artisanal American cheese can be.
name: Uplands Cheese Company

description_raw: Lamers Dairy is a Wisconsin, family-owned, independent milk bottling plant, where all producer milk is Farmer Certified rBGH free. When Jacob Lamers, Sr. started Lamers Dairy in 1913 in Kimberly, Wisconsin, raw milk was distributed to the villagers in preserve cans, which were delivered to customers as members of the family went to school in the morning. In 1998, the business moved to their current location in Appleton, Wisconsin. Today, Lamers is still a family operation.
name: Lamers Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: Agropur, Inc. is a worldwide supplier of award-winning cheeses. With more than 300 employees across Weyauwega, Little Chute, and Luxemburg, Wisconsin, Agropur's rich tradition is the gold standard by which so many other cheesemakers measure their products. In fact, five cheesemakers at Agropur have earned the prestigious Wisconsin Master Cheesemaker certification. Since 1938, Agropur has remained an organization with humble roots and the highest expectations for cheese.
name: Agropur, Inc.

description_raw: Crave Brothers Farmstead Classics are specialty cheeses produced with fresh, high quality milk from the Crave Brothers Dairy Farm in rural Wisconsin where licensed cheesemakers bring over 45 years of combined cheesemaking experience. The cheese factory is integrated from crops to cows, milk to cheese. Four Crave brothers founded the dairy farm and cheese factory, and now the next generation is continuing the legacy and work together to manage the farm and cheese plant. Cheeses are crafted with great care using old world techniques. Their hard work has paid off with over 100 awards and lots of love from us here in Wisconsin. Crave Brothers Farmstead Classics are the cheese craver's choice!
name: Crave Brothers Farmstead Cheese, L.L.C.

description_raw: Willow Creek Cheese has been making the finest cheese possible since August 2002. Willow Creek is associated with Union Star Cheese where the Metzig family has been making cheese for 100 years. You can find Willow Creek's artisanal cheeses made at this facility. This is the real deal: A rural cheese factory in Berlin, Wisconsin, selling assorted cheeses and, of course, fresh cheese curds.
name: Willow Creek Cheese

description_raw: Ken Meixelsperger, the founder of Wisconsin’s Finest, Inc., was born and raised in Wisconsin and knows just about everything there is to know about cheese. After forty years in the business, Ken intimately knows the cheese industry. From milking cows on a dairy farm as a child to becoming a licensed cheesemaker and grader, and now owning and operating his own cheese manufacturing plant in Wisconsin, Ken started Wisconsin’s Finest in 1986. Today, you'll find Wisconsin’s Finest anywhere from your local grocery store’s dairy department to the shredded cheese on your salad at your favorite restaurant. Wisconsin’s Finest provides customers with complete cheese lines in foodservice, deli and retail throughout the U.S., straight from the rolling hills of Wisconsin.
name: Wisconsin's Finest

description_raw: Founded with a goal of bringing the best Italian cheeses to the American market, Schuman Cheese offers a host of expanded capabilities that complement its original import business. With a worldwide network of partners and customers, this Italian cheese leader from Wisconsin is now applying decades of experience to flourish as a cheesemaker, processor and product innovator. Arthur Schuman’s passion and energy has been passed down generation after generation - for seven decades now! This has helped build a modest import business into a well-recognized and respected leader in the cheese industry both in the United States and abroad.
name: Schuman Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: All Star, Ltd. is a company from Fond du Lac, Wisconsin, that does it all. Established in 1991, All Star offers private label retail, deli, and foodservice packaging as well as their own deli and foodservice products. Our favorite part about All Star? They can provide any type of cheese in any form possible or custom manufacture to your exact specifications. All Star will bring all of your wildest cheese fantasies to life!
name: All Star, LTD

description_raw: Winona Foods Inc. quickly has become a leader in dairy risk management. With direct contact with over 84 production facilities, Winona offers the cheese you want to buy, rather than the cheese they have to sell. Winona specializes in contract packaging and private label for a wide range of natural cheese, so they can meet your needs from bulk packs to a variety of retail packaged cheese cuts, shreds, cubes to various other styles. Winona also manufactures a line of dips, spreads and sauces in a range of packaging options. With dozens of products and flexibility in packaging and processing options, Winona is your single source for quality dairy products.
name: Winona Foods, Inc.

description_raw: Crystal Ball Farms is owned and operated by Troy and Barb DeRosier and located along the beautiful St. Croix River in Osceola, Wisconsin. As a small family-owned business, they control all aspects of their products from growing the crops that cows eat to processing milk right on the farm. Other brands of dairy products may be weeks old before they get to the store. At Crystal Ball Farms, products are sent to the consumer directly from the farm creamery, where fresh products are made every day! In addition, Crystal Ball Farms also offers their own line of frozen pizzas made with hand-tossed dough, which they sell to local retailers and foodservice establishments.
name: Crystal Ball Farms

description_raw: Dupont Cheese is a family-owned business where five generations of cheesemakers have been making cheese for over 50 years. Featuring cheeses made on location, you are guaranteed the best quality cheese around. Dupont also manufactures high-quality Cheddar, fresh squeaky Colby, Monterey Jack, Gouda, smoked Gouda, Rainbow, Habanero and Pepper cheese. They make fresh curds every Thursday and Friday, and cheeses are available through mail order. Visit the store and find out for yourself why they're Wisconsin's best kept secret!
name: Dupont Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: Rich in the tradition of Wisconsin cheesemaking, Springside Cheese carries on a family legacy of producing the finest hand-crafted, natural cheeses. Established in 1908 and purchased in 1973 by Wayne Hintz and family, today Springside integrates the passion of four generations of cheesemakers and the legacy of Wisconsin cheesemaking to create their hand-crafted, award-winning cheese. Springside remains one of Northeast Wisconsin’s longest running factories, but they're always looking toward the future. They look forward to creating and introducing an exquisite line of artisan and organic cheeses, using inspiration from their own German heritage as well as other rich flavors they love. Making cheese is their family tradition - and serving it should be yours!
name: Springside Cheese Corporation

description_raw: Wisconsin has an impressive Guinness Book of World Records claim to fame. In 1995, Jim Knaus, President of Weyauwega Star Dairy, made the World Records for making the longest string cheese in the world (1.5 miles long). Strong men and women had to carry it through the town on their shoulders! Jim is clearly passionate about cheese making, and we can tell his passion also includes a great sense of fun. You'll find Jim and the rest of Star Dairy in the tiny central Wisconsin town of Weyauwega, Wisconsin, where the company has been operated by the Knaus Family since 1975. They are artisan cheesemakers specializing in handcrafted Italian cheese such as parmesan, asiago, and romano. Jim was born into cheesemaking. He literally grew up in a cheese vat. His parents put him there so they could watch him while they worked.
name: Weyauwega Star Dairy, Inc.

description_raw: Family Fresh Pack (FFP) was established in 1995 as a specialty cheese packaging converter. In the heart of cheese country, many specialty cheesemakers have found FFP to be a creative and high quality packager. Besides the normal deli style cut and wrapping, filling cheese crumbles and shreds into retail deli cups, and making cheese spreads was added to their capabilities in 1997. But wait, there's even more! Further product development came with the addition of nut covered cheeseballs and cheese logs. The future is bright for Family Fresh Pack, as the expanded production capabilities make them an ideal partner in the growing Wisconsin specialty cheese industry.
name: Family Fresh Pack LLC

description_raw: Edelweiss Creamery is a small artisan Wisconsin cheese factory employing state-of-the-art technology alongside the tried and true traditional method of cheesemaking. It was established in 1873 and is still at the same location, which means the Edelweiss experience brings you back to a time when the quality and the flavor was king! Edelweiss Creamery employs the highest certified Master Cheesemaker in the United States, Bruce Workman. Bruce has graduated from the Wisconsin Master Cheesemaker Program™ seven times and holds 12 certifications. His expertise enables Edelweiss to continue to make award-winning cheese, like the Edelweiss Emmentaler cheese that brings a little bit of Switzerland to Monticello, Wisconsin. The unequaled taste of this cheese is a must for the serious cheese lover!
name: Edelweiss Creamery

description_raw: Located in the Wisconsin countryside, Pine River has been making award-winning cheese spreads since 1963. The richness of Wisconsin’s Dairyland right in our backyard, combined with state-of-the art equipment, exacting manufacturing standards, and highly trained cheese spread makers ensure skillfully crafted cheese spreads with every batch. Pine River manufactures the most award-winning cheese spreads in the world and our cheese spreads are made with only the highest quality Wisconsin Grade A Dairy ingredients. Pine River invites you to Taste the Award-Winning Difference.
name: Pine River Pre Pack, Inc

description_raw: The story of Kraemer Wisconsin Cheese begins in the small Wisconsin community of Watertown. It was here that Tony Kraemer, a lifelong farmer, decided to build a small dairy business on his property. Could Tony, the patriarch of the Kraemer family enterprise, ever have envisioned that three generations later, his family would still be carrying on the tradition for fine dairy products and service he began in the 1920s? Perhaps not, but that's where Kraemer is today! What started as a family farm and door-to-door milk route is now a high-end cheese retailer, carrying on Tony's legacy as a shining example of hard work, family values, attention to detail and quality products.
name: Kraemer Wisconsin Cheese Ltd

description_raw: From countryside picnics to elegant wine and cheese spreads, Northwoods Cheese Company offers a full selection of quality and flavorful cheese, sausage, cutting boards and gourmet snack products for every occasion. Make sure you get your next party started with this specialty cheese company!
name: Northwoods Cheese Company, LLC

description_raw: Marieke Penterman was born and raised in the Netherlands on a 60-cow dairy farm, so her move to Thorp, Wisconsin, with her husband Rolf in 2002 was a natural first step in carrying out their shared passion for dairy farming. In 2006, desperately missing their gouda from Holland, Marieke and Rolf embarked on a new adventure in cheesemaking. Using farmstead-fresh, raw cow's milk from their family farm, Marieke began crafting authentic Dutch cheeses. The milk is piped directly from the cows into the cheese-processing vat after the first milking of the day, and its freshness is unrivaled. The awards are proof: Just one year after Marieke crafted her first batch of gouda in November 2006, she captured a gold award at the U.S. Champion Cheese Contest in 2007. Dozens of awards have followed including the biggest win, the U.S. Grand Champion in 2013. Marieke brought her time-tested, Old World cheesemaking methods to us from the Netherlands, and we're glad she's here in Wisconsin!
name: Hollands Family Cheese - Marieke Gouda

description_raw: Third generation cheesemaker, Bill Novak II, spent the early years of his life learning the art of cheesemaking alongside his father. After studying agricultural business at the University of Wisconsin-Platteville, working in natural cheese cutting and processing at Safeway and working in the procurement department of Great Lakes Cheese, Bill developed a great understanding of cheese production and the processed cheese field. Since forming Novak’s Cheese in 2006, Bill continues to use his knowledge to relate to customers' wants, needs and ongoing issues, as well as to keep up with trends in the industry. Bill is a licensed Wisconsin cheese grader and, of course, proud Wisconsinite!
name: Novak's Cheese of Wisconsin, Inc.

description_raw: At Harmony Cheese, we craft and ship exceptional Wisconsin cheese, bringing our passion for flavor and tradition straight to your door. Whether you crave a sharp cheddar or dream of creamy Abergele, we've got you covered. We're dedicated to quality, championing cheese with the same fervor Wisconsin fans show their team. Explore a world of delicious possibilities with us. Discover our Golden Age line, where excellence meets unique flavor. Try our Traditional Abergele, Abergele Cranberry and Orange, Kidwelly, Abergele Portabella and Chive, Aged Double Gloucester, or Merlot-Infused White Cheddar. Cheese for everyone. And we mean everyone!
name: Harmony Cheese

description_raw: Roelli Cheese Haus is a small, family-owned cheese factory that has been in the same location for nearly 100 years. Known for award-winning, specialty cheddar-blue cheeses, Dunbarton Blue and Red Rock, Roelli also makes fresh cheddar curds, cellar-aged cheddars and small batch artisan varieties, including the alpine-style cheese, Little Mountain, which was named the 2016 American Cheese Society Best in Show. Fourth generation cheesemaker and co-owner, Chris Roelli, is one of Wisconsin's distinguished Master Cheesemakers and a fine craftsman of those award-winning original recipe cheeses we know you'll love. If you're wondering what cheddar-blue is all about, look no further. Roelli will show you all you've been missing!
name: Roelli Cheese Company, Inc.

description_raw: Yellowstone Cheese opened its doors halfway between the North Pole and the Equator, in Cadott, Wisconsin, on November 14, 2007. Cheesemaker Dave Anderson brings over 15 years of experience to Yellowstone Cheese. The company uses milk proudly sourced from a farm locally owned by Jeremy and Heidi Kenealy (and their children Brad and Brooke). The Kenealy Farm is a Grade A, BGH-Free farm only 200 yards away from the factory, where it's so close that the milk is hauled over in a bulk tank on wheels, where it's crafted into a variety of cheeses using colby, monterey jack, or cheddar for the base. And why the Yellowstone name in Wisconsin? Turns out the factory is located on the Yellowstone Trail - the first automobile route from Plymouth Rock to Puget Sound!
name: Yellowstone Cheese, Inc.

description_raw: Oshkosh – no, not the overalls – is a wholesale distributor of bulk cheese. For more than 60 years, Oshkosh Cold Storage has specialized in the aging and sales of quality bulk Wisconsin cheddar cheese. They have premium moisture cheese for aging made to specifications set by Wisconsin's finest cheese factories. They have yellow and white cheddar in 40- and 640-pound blocks ranging from mild to extra sharp flavor profiles available for sale. Plus, they have two state-of-the-art, storage facilities that offer a capacity of nearly 20 million cubic feet of cheese storage with multiple temperature options to customize a curing process to meet your requirements. Is there anything they can't do? (Maybe overalls.)
name: Oshkosh Cheese Sales

description_raw: Award-winning cheese and butter maker, Al Bekkum, and his family have lived on the Bekkum Farmstead since emigrating from Norway back in 1917. Their farm is located in the midst of other Norwegian settlers in Westby, Wisconsin, within Vernon County's lush, green hills and valleys known as the Coulee Region. This un-glaciated land is known for its fertile soil and exceptional grazing land, making their cheese and butter second to none. Bekkum family members are not only involved in dairy farming, but also in cheese making. Their happy cows and goats produce some of the freshest milk in the area, which leads to happy cheese and a happy you!
name: Nordic Creamery

description_raw: Keystone Farms Cheese was established in 2014 after owner, Nikole Raskovich, spent years traveling from Pennsylvania to Wisconsin to visit her father and grandmother. She soon realized the taste, quality, and unique flavors found in Wisconsin cheese were not available back home in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. Today, Keystone Farms Cheese distributes over six tons of Wisconsin cheese each year to restaurants, wineries, small businesses, and local craft and wine festivals in Eastern Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and upstate New York. Since those early days in a one-room office in Nikole’s one-car garage, Keystone Farms Cheese believes in real cheese with real ingredients. They work directly with small family farms and factories throughout Wisconsin to source the highest quality, handcrafted products for our cheese-loving fans.
name: Keystone Farms Cheese

description_raw: Red Barn Family Farms is proud to bring you artisan cheese made from premium milk in the lush green landscape of eastern Wisconsin. Their mission can be summed up in 3 simple, but powerful, words: Reinvigorate, Honor, Sustain. They seek to reinvigorate Wisconsin family-owned dairy farms by creating an economy that will value these farms for generations. They honor and sustain Wisconsin’s rich family dairy farming heritage through a revolutionary new pay structure for farmers that rewards both excellent milk quality and animal husbandry. And Red Barn is passionate about one more simple belief: the healthiest cows make the best milk.
name: Red Barn Family Farms

description_raw: For over 10 years, W&W has been providing delicious Mexican style cheeses throughout the United States. David Webster, one of the owners, learned how to make Mexican cheese directly from the source, a small manufacturer in Mexico. W&W Dairy's several varieties of cheese today include fresco, enchilada, quesadilla, quesadilla with jalapeño, shredded quesadilla, cotija and asadero. Newly added to the product line are cheddar-style, monterey jack-style and colby-style cheeses, and W&W's own label brand, Queso Del Rey. You may also know Queso Del Rey Fresco as the Gold Medal Winner from the 2012 World Championship Cheese Contest!
name: W&W Dairy, LLC

description_raw: Cesar Luis learned the art of making cheese by hand as a young boy in Oaxaca, Mexico. He followed his dream to make cheese in Wisconsin, earned his Wisconsin Cheesemaker's License, and launched Cesar's Cheese in 2008. Today, Cesar crafts queso oaxaca completely by hand, stretching it into 15-pound, 50 foot ropes, which are cut into sticks of string cheese. At the 2023 United States Championship Cheese Contest, Cesar's Cheese's Hand Stretched String Cheese swept the String Cheese category, winning Best of Class, Second Award and Third Award. Don't forget to also check out Cesar's handcrafted queso fresco, queso quesadilla, mozzarella, and fresh cheddar curds!
name: Cesar's Cheese LLC

description_raw: If you're looking for cheese spreads and liver pâté, you're in luck because Malcore Foods, Inc. manufacturers both! They also produce cut and wrapped Wisconsin cheeses, including fresh cheddar cheese curds (other flavors are garlic, dill and jalapeño), and a line of Wisconsin cheeses from mozzarella to string. Arthur Bay Cheese Company located in Appleton, Wisconsin features all these products and many other quality Wisconsin products. Pro tip: You will also find Butterfly Gardens of Wisconsin in Appleton, not quite cheese, but an enjoyable second!
name: Malcore Foods

description_raw: Wisconsin Aging & Grading Cheese, Inc. (WAG Cheese) is the wholesale custom sourcing specialist for quality cheddar cheese aged from 3 months to 17 years. For over 22 years, they have offered a number of services from grading, aging programs, spot sales, and flavor profiling to warehousing and financing programs. They now also offer the 724 Wisconsin Select retail line of aged cheddars the brand name highlights company founder and 2nd generation licensed cheese grader Ken Neumeier's Wisconsin Graders Number. As a family owned business, WAG Cheese always operates under the highest integrity, honesty, and loyalty. Cheese is their family's legacy, and they look forward to being around for generations to come.
name: Wisconsin Aging & Grading Cheese, Inc

description_raw: Barron County Cheese began production on December 1, 2010, when founders Gene Graf, Sal DiStasio, and Paul Brzezienski joined their visions to become an industry leader in cheese packaging and conversion. They also specialize in natural cold smoking and waxing applications, providing services highlighted with unmatched quality. The team-oriented company spends every day helping clients across the U.S. get their cheese products ready for retail. We're glad they do what they do!
name: Heartisan Foods

description_raw: Founded by Huma Siddiqui in 2004, and now proudly run by both Huma and her son, Samir Karimi, White Jasmine is a leader in creating and introducing new, exotic, and flavorful products for the market. White Jasmine Gouda cheeses are infused with Huma Siddiqui's exotic and signature spices. Three gouda cheeses, Tandoori, Sajji BBQ and Cumin are unique and enriched with outstanding flavors. All ingredients are natural, gluten-free, and are chosen thoughtfully, using rBST free milk and absolutely no preservatives. White Jasmine supports products with frequent live demos, recipe ideas/cards, distributor discounts, and money-off coupons, so keep an eye out for these ways of trying your new favorite exotic cheeses!
name: White Jasmine LLC

description_raw: Associated Milk Producers Inc. (AMPI) is a dairy marketing cooperative owned by 2,000 farm families and operated by its 1,200 employees. Dairy farm owners produce high-quality milk on family farms across Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, South Dakota and North Dakota. AMPI's own packaging and processing plant is proudly located in Portage, Wisconsin, and they have cheese plants in Jim Falls, Wisconsin and Blair, Wisconsin. Their diversity in production is an asset to many customers here in Wisconsin and beyond.
name: Associated Milk Producers, Inc.

description_raw: LaClare Family Creamery is a true farmstead operation established in 1978 with a foundation that is rooted in artistry, family values and hard work. In the late 70s, eager to return to their rural roots, Larry and Clara Hedrich bought a hobby farm in the heart of America’s Dairyland. Along with their homestead, they inherited two goats, a dozen or so chickens and pair of peacocks. Little did they realize that the goats would soon become the focal point of the lives of their growing family. Hence, the founding of what would become LaClare Farms, appropriately named after founders Larry and Clara. Today, the company makes a variety of goat milk cheeses, raw and pasteurized cheddar, jack, fresh chevre and various Evalon cheeses in both wheels and blocks. We especially recommend checking out their signature cheese Evalon, a fruity nutty aged goat milk cheese with an asiago finish. Evalon was named “Best of Show” out of 1,604 different cheeses at the U.S. Championship Cheese Contest.
name: LaClare Family Creamery

description_raw: We are not cheesemakers, we're cheese hotrodders. We like to put a twist on classics by asking"What if?" Starting with an inspiration, we experiment with different flavors, cultures and affinage techniques. Our goal is to imagine something unique-something shareable. Our cheeses are our family's kitchen counter creations come to life at the hands of some of Wisconsin's greatest Master Cheesemakers. We continuously tweak each recipe with our cheesemaking partners to create cheeses that are characterful, inspiring both the cheese lover and cheese professional with whimsical personality, creative flavor and consistent quality. For us, it's so important that we choose the best of the best every step of the way. Our cheeses start with nutrient rich milk from small, local family farms. The terroir of Wisconsin's Kettle Moraine offers these farmers' herds lush summer grazing, sweet winter feed and fresh limestone-filtered water. We keep it clean and simple-just adding salt, enzymes and cultures-to the fresh milk to stay true to time-honored cheesemaking traditions. For a kick of whimsy, we add fresh ground vanilla bean, dried habanero peppers, juniper berries, caraway seeds and black truffles to some;for others we bathe them in premium liqueurs. Underneath it all, Deer Creek cheeses are created with love. We're just as proud to share them with our own loved ones as we are to share them with you. They're our family's perfect gift, backed by life-long industry experience, passion for affinage and rigorous cheese grading programs. Every time you enjoy a Deer Creek cheese, you can feel confident that you're tasting something we feel is truly special.
name: Deer Creek Cheese

description_raw: Andrew and Everett are all about the cheese! Responsibly raised cows, U.S. family-owned self-sustaining farms, standards of excellence in ingredients, production and freshness all combine to provide a full line of all-natural cheeses that are rBGH-BST hormone free, gluten free, antibiotic free and made with no preservatives, binders or fillers. The Andrew & Everett mission is to support self-sustaining family farms, and they strive for excellence in both the quality and taste of their cheese. They make every effort to clearly define their products' natural attributes so consumers can make clear and definitive choices for themselves and their families.
name: PANOS Brands

description_raw: McCluskey Brothers Organic Farms is a small, diversified, 100% grass-fed, certified organic family farm in southern Wisconsin. Certified organic since 1996, they offer beef, cheese and maple syrup, taking great pride in their fresh farm products of exceptional quality that come direct from Shillelagh Glen Farms to your table!
name: McCluskey Brothers

description_raw: G&R Foods, formed in 1995 in Reedsburg, Wisconsin, is a second-generation, family-owned company that specializes in selling cheeses, butter, and dairy powders from experienced and proven sources located in the heart of America's Dairyland. With almost 70 years of combined sourcing, manufacturing, and distribution experience in various dairy products, G&R Foods proves their values of fairness, honesty and respect in every transaction. Give them a call!
name: G&R Foods, Inc

description_raw: The scientific term for yummy is umami! More than any of the other tastes, more than salty or sweet or sour or bitter, umami is what makes you crave certain foods. It is savory, earthy, and exquisite, lingering on the tongue and in the mouth and awakening the senses without overpowering them. This is the flavor of LaBelle™ cheese. With more than 135 years of dairy farming heritage in southeastern Wisconsin, the Koepke family introduces LaBelle™, their farmhouse cheese crafted only with the premium milk from their Holstein dairy cows. This Wisconsin Original is made in small batches under the careful supervision of a Master Cheesemaker whose family-owned cheese plant has been in operation for more than 125 years. Give it a try, it's umami!
name: Koepke Farms, Inc

description_raw: The Weyauwega story began over 100 years ago, in 1912, when Edward and Pauline Knaus set out to create Wisconsin’s finest cheese. They carefully crafted a variety of quality cheeses from the finest ingredients; the most important being family pride. As their cheese making businesses grew, the family also grew into second, third, and now fourth generations, and each has been involved in different aspects of dairy farming and cheesemaking. Although much has changed, each generation has been united in their shared commitment to producing Wisconsin’s Finest. Today, the family still begins their work with milk from local family dairy farms, manufactures products in state-of-the-art facilities, and concentrates on sourcing and distributing Wisconsin’s Finest cheese throughout the U.S. Weyauwega understands that the word Weyauwega may be difficult to pronounce. Just remember: It's "Y-O-WE-GA” - or, "Wisconsin’s Finest".
name: Weyauwega Cheese

description_raw: In August 2013, over homemade Old Fashioneds, two Annas plotted a partnership around their dreams of creamy, buttery sheep and cow milk, carefully handcrafted into beautiful, delicious cheese. Anna Landmark, a small farm owner, and Anna Thomas Bates, a food writer, met at a potluck for Green County Women in Sustainable Agriculture. Today, they produce sheep and pasture grazed cow milk cheese on their farm. Petit Nuage, a fresh sheep milk cheese, won a gold medal in the 2015 U.S. Cheese Championship Contest. Anabasque, a washed rind, cave-aged sheep milk cheese, is inspired by the cheeses of the Basque region. Tallgrass Reserve is a pasture-grazed cow milk cheese aged 6-12 months. A little piece of land, a Swiss grandfather, a noisy milk cow named Freckles, a flock of wild sheep, two goats named Giselle and Celeste and a passion for local food and cooking are the roots of Landmark Creamery.
name: Landmark Creamery LLC

description_raw: Brigitte Mizrahi started Anderson International Foods, Inc., in 1997 when she identified an unmet niche in the market: artisanal kosher cheeses. Mizrahi’s French heritage and passion inspired her two original brands: "Natural and kosher" and "Les Petites Fermieres.” Her most recent brand, "Sincerely, Brigitte™," offers unique blends of bold flavor, fresh herbs, and standout packaging design. Brigitte is always looking for ways to spice things up, bringing together bold, sweet, spicy, and savory into the most exciting combinations that any cheese enthusiast is bound to love!
name: Anderson International Foods

description_raw: It all started when a group of experienced butchers and seasoned sausage makers wanted to make some of the best meat products around. With this goal in mind, a team assembled to create what is now known as StoneRidge Piggly Wiggly, formerly known as StoneRidge Meat and Country Market, Inc. Since opening their wholesale division in 2008, they've been offering wholesale services to a variety of businesses and organizations - from grocery stores to restaurants and gas stations to fundraisers. Choose from several product lines, including over 90 varieties of cheese and over 200 varieties of sausage, smoked meats and bratwurst, and visit their store on the south side of Highway 21 for a beautiful, rustic shopping experience!
name: StoneRidge Meat & Country Market

description_raw: Terry Woods has done it all. He’s taught scuba diving, worked with computers and learned to fly airplanes and helicopters. In addition, in 2015, he became a licensed cheesemaker in Wisconsin. Terry and his wife of 43 years, Denise, lived on an old dairy farm for decades but had never milked a cow. So, he decided to buy one and started milking by hand. That was the start of Highfield Farm Creamery where the couple now runs the state’s smallest milking parlor and sells handcrafted curds and cave-aged cheeses.
name: Highfield Farm Creamery

description_raw: Wakker’s Creamy crafts a traditional farmstead gouda, made by Johannes and his family team, wife Olga, daughter Iuliia and son in law Sergii. Johannes stems from a long tradition of Dutch dairy farmers. He was born and spent his early forming years on his grandmother’s farmstead in Aalsmeer, located near Amsterdam, Holland. Johannes along with his family decided to come to Wisconsin to pursue his dream of owning a dairy farm, starting with a small operation in 1988. Johannes adapted to the changing dairy industry through the years, and in 2010, began making gouda in Wisconsin after an inspiring visit with family overseas. Today, Wakker’s Creamy is made with raw, high-solids milk from Wakker’s Dairy, just south of Kewaunee. Johannes's cheesemaking equipment has been shipped in from the Netherlands, and ingredients used in Wakker's cheese are sourced from Holland. The result of this incredible mix of Dutch ingredients and local milk is a unique gouda with a Wisconsin twist.
name: Wakker Cheese LLC

description_raw: Founded in 2018, Integrity Cheese Packaging of Wisconsin is uniquely positioned to offer the benefits of a larger cut-and-wrap facility--including SQF Level 3 certification--to manufacturers of smaller, niche product lines.
name: Integrity Cheese Packaging of WI

description_raw: MCT Dairies delivers high-quality products, services, and specialized formulations at the best possible price and with complete logistics and customer service support. They are able to assist customers in product development, sourcing, purchasing, logistics and inventory management.
name: MCT Dairies, Inc.

description_raw: Kingston Amish farm traditions include allowing their cows and goats to graze on pasture when Wisconsin weather permits and hand milking using old-fashioned milk cans. The extra care and centuries-old practice is reflected in the luscious, high-quality milk and extraordinary blue cheeses crafted by their award-winning cheesemakers.
name: Kingston Cheese Co-op

description_raw: The Clearview Dairy journey began in 2016 when Louis and Jenny Averbeck purchased dairy cows from Louis' parents, making them the 6th generation on the farm, which has been in the Averbeck family since 1848. They recognized a growing need for dairy products that people with dairy sensitivities would enjoy, and started an A1 beta casein free herd of Holsteins and Jerseys. Their cows enjoy seasonal access to pasture and high forage diets that are filled with vitamins, minerals and probiotics, and free of animal byproducts. They are a family-based farm devoted to working together and carrying the generational farm onward.
name: Clearview Dairy aTwo Cheese LLC

description_raw: Palmetto Cheese - Homestyle Pimento Cheese was born in the Lowcountry of South Carolina, and the recipe originated on Pawleys Island, SC at the historic Sea View Inn. It is a mixture of aged Wisconsin sharp cheddar, mayonnaise, cream cheese, pimentos, onions, and a unique combination of spices. Since 2006, Palmetto Cheese has adorned grocery store shelves with our rich and delicious spread that tastes like southern hospitality combined with award-winning Wisconsin cheese. Available in original, jalapeño, bacon and pepper jack varieties, Palmetto Cheese is gluten free and can be used in recipes, served with crackers and vegetables, made into a grilled cheese sandwich, or simply enjoyed with a spoon!
name: Palmetto Cheese

description_raw: In the heart of America’s Dairyland, the green rolling hills surrounding the Hoard’s Dairyman Farm create a near perfect backdrop for a special herd of Guernsey cows. W.D. Hoard, pioneering publisher and former Governor of Wisconsin, established his dairy farm in 1899 and went on to change dairying across the land forever. Today, descendants of Hoard’s original Guernsey cows continue to call the Hoard’s Dairyman Farm their home, and they continue to produce the extraordinary milk that makes our very special cheese.
name: Hoard's Dairymen Farm Creamery

description_raw: Specializing in natural 'affinage' techniques, Alpinage™ Artisan Cheese makes semi-hard, smear ripened cheeses all year long. Born in France with a passion for food, Orphee Paillotin followed a food industry career that moved him across the Atlantic Ocean to America’s Dairyland: Wisconsin. Each cheesemaking day begins at the crack of dawn by bringing in fresh, raw milk straight from the farm to the make room to create alpine-style cheeses in their farmstead creamery. Paillotin handcrafts two versions of Mount Raclette cheese. The mild is sweet, buttery and a true crowd pleaser. The classic is rich and nutty with earthy notes, melting like a champion. All Alpinage cheeses are cellar-aged 60 days on rustic wood boards.
name: Alpinage Cheese LLC

description_raw: Founded in 2021 by Mike Harris and Josh Ptaszynski, THE BIG MOO specializes in baked cheese handcrafted using milk sourced from local dairy farms with happy cows. Fresh curds are pressed into slabs and baked until the outside turns a toasty brown reminiscent of crusty bread. This mild, buttery-flavored cheese is squeaky and firm when cold but turns silky smooth when heated. Originally from Finland, baked cheese, also known as bread cheese or juustoleipä, is an American take on a Scandinavian favorite. Working in partnership with a fourth-generation cheesemaker, THE BIG MOO comes in six unique flavors: Oh So Original; Bakin’ Bacon; Cheesy Pizza; Roasted Garlic; Hoppin’ Jalapeno, and Harvest Cranberry. Grounded in a belief that good food brings families together, THE BIG MOO aims to share their love of baked cheese with the whole country.
name: Cheeses of Wisconsin (The Big Moo)
